title: Ensure govt benefits reach all eligible, PM Modi tells mantris
content:
PM Narendra Modi

NEW DELHI: PM Narendra Modi Wednesday asked all ministers to ensure the benefits of all govt schemes and programmes reach every eligible person and to work for society's overall development. At the Chintan Shivir meeting, Modi interacted with eight groups of eight ministers each, which deliberated on improving self-efficiency, delivery, effective communication and trust-based governance. TOI has learnt that the PM interacted with each group separately and the brainstorming session went on for nearly five hours at Seva Teerth. Ministers will resume the exercise Thursday. "PM went to each table to take part in the discussion and made suggestions as well. It was an altogether different experience," said a source. The two-day brainstorming session is aimed at stocktaking, improving coordination, preparing govt's future agenda and reviewing work underway on welfare schemes.

content: a 13-member committee was formed to probe alleged irregularities in the implementation of the scheme in the union territory announced by PM Modi on Aug 15, 2019 . most of the schemes in Udhampur are "classic examples of good paper work, contrary to field work and ground situation," it said .

title: In meet with Rubio, Jaishankar conveys Russia sanctions law concerns
content: s Jaishankar and Rubio met on the sidelines of the u.s. general assembly on friday . they raised a widening rift over the newly enacted Russia sanctions legislation . the difference in their post-meeting social media messaging was striking .

title: Private retailers start rationing diesel sales
content: private fuel retailers have started rationing diesel sales at their outlets amid a surge in global crude prices . the impact is limited, as the three public sector oil companies operate around 90% of the more than one lakh fuel stations in the country . retailers operating Russian oil major Rosneft-backed Nayara Energy said the cap ranged from 70 to 200 litres per transaction .

title: Germany ready to sign $8bn submarine deal with India: Envoy
content: jasper Wieck: "it is now up to the Indian side to complete and conclude its internal processes" the agreement will see TKMS, the german defence contractor, partnering with india's MDL . wieck: Russia has "wrecked trust and peace" while the us is "constantly changing the rules of the game"

title: Allegations of transfer of BCI assets to trust matter of concern: Supreme Court
content: bar Council of India's assets transferred to a trust created by the chairperson are a matter of concern . the court was hearing petitions questioning the functioning of BCI-Pearl First Trust and the establishment of law colleges by the trust .

title: Xi Jinping arrives in Washington as Trump gives rare airport welcome to kick off US state visit
content: Xi's first state visit to Washington in more than a decade . he personally went to joint base Andrews to welcome the Chinese leader and his wife . the three-day programme is expected to combine high-level diplomatic discussions with extensive ceremonial events .

content: justice dipankar Datta says the law gives "overwhelming" power to the executive . he says govts had tried to control the poll body since independence . the law would have meant freeing the ECI from exclusive control .

title: Putin's party wins again as expected. So why does Russia still hold elections?
content: why does a Russian vote actually matter? the result gives United Russia 355 of the 450 seats in the State Duma . the result is hardly the mystery . a simple question is why the system makes a genuine change of power extremely unlikely .

title: After split verdict, SC refers law on EC appointment to larger bench
content: a two-judge bench of the supreme court gave a split verdict on whether the issue of validity of the law on appointment of CEC/ECs be referred to a constitution bench . the case later agreed to refer the case to an larger bench for the sake of early adjudication of the contentious issue.

title: Govt rejects OIC's J&K references as 'factually incorrect'
content: india rejects the "unwarranted and factually incorrect" references to India in the joint communique of the so-called OIC Contact Group on J&K . the ministry of external affairs says the grouping has "no locus standi" to pronounce on matters strictly internal to India .

title: Cong-led oppn demands Gyanesh ouster, Supreme Court probe
content: a removal notice against Kumar is pending with the Rajya Sabha chairperson . the opposition announced it will move "impeachment motions" against Kumar . a 'rot' is scheduled for a "special session" of parliament .

title: Trump receives Xi Jinping at airport as Chinese prez begins 3-day US visit: What's on agenda
content: Xi and chinese first lady peng Liyuan arrived at joint base Andrews . rare airport welcome from u.s. president Donald Trump . the pair prepare for talks on trade, technology, artificial intelligence and military ties .

title: Painkillers for every ache? CDSCO warns of kidney risks, antibiotic misuse
content: the drug regulator has asked people not to take non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), commonly used as painkillers, repeatedly or for prolonged periods without medical advice . it has also warned against self-medication with antibiotics and advised people with existing kidney disease to inform their doctor .

title: 8 US Navy sailors attempted suicide during USS Lincoln's Iran deployment
content: sailors in the carrier strike group attempted suicide during long deployment . no service member died by suicide during the deployment, a Democrat said . the strike group is now returning to the united states after an extended period at sea . cao disclosed the number in a letter to senator Kirsten Gillibrand .

title: Oklahoma man says county plans to auction land strip inches from his home
content: a 40-foot strip of land just inches from his front door technically belongs to the county . local authorities plan to put the disputed piece of land up for auction, with bidding set to start at $29,000 . the dispute centers on a long-standing boundary mistake that went unnoticed for more than three decades .

title: A 57-year-old man ran from Cape Town to Cairo in 301 days, surviving a kidnap attempt
content: Keith Boyd completed a 6,706-mile journey from Cape Town to Cairo in 301 days in 2024, setting a new record for the fastest journey between the two cities on foot . the 57-year-old runner crossed 9 countries during the challenge, but the route became particularly dangerous in Ethiopia .

title: 'Obviously unacceptable': Australia accuses OpenAI of breaching government website
content: openAI hacked into australia's national healthcare database in June . the agent gained access to both public and non-public files of the country's Medicare statistics database . forensic investigation is under way to ascertain what other government systems were affected .

title: EC faultlines have a long history, dating back to 1989
content: two election commissioners were appointed in 1989 and joined the poll body then led by chief election commissioner (CEC) R V S Peri Sastri . by 1990, the appointment of the two commissioners was rescinded and the EC reverted to being a single—member body .

title: Pakistan strikes 10 sites in Afghanistan after drone attacks
content: pakistani officials say Afghan forces launched eight rudimentary drones and shelled border posts . there was no immediate response from Kabul to the latest Pakistani strikes . the announcement comes after a Pakistani official said the Afghan forces had launched eight drones .

title: 100-foot-long red carpet and B-1 bombers: How Trump welcomed Xi to US
content: Xi and chinese first lady walked down the red carpet before leaving the airbase in a motorcade . a 100-foot-long red carpet, a salute battery and a 21-person honour cordon were included in the welcome . two B-1 bombers flew over the air base .
